rules.requirement: Jenkins builds an OCI image from a pinned source commit, pushes it to the local registry, and the application Deployment uses its sha256 digest.
Application pods run as non-root with no privilege escalation and a read-only root filesystem.
The application has one HTTP service port, uses a ClusterIP Service, and is routed by the platform Traefik Ingress.
rules.reason: ClusterIP, Traefik Ingress, and HTTP / check

rules.requirement: The application exposes separate liveness and readiness probes; readiness checks its PostgreSQL dependency.

rules.requirement: Relational data uses the CloudNativePG provisioned PostgreSQL service and application credentials from the operator-generated Secret.
rules.reason: CloudNativePG readiness and application DB wiring

rules.requirement: Schema and seed SQL run as an Argo CD PreSync Job before the application rolls, with startup DDL disabled.
rules.reason: PreSync Job completion and disabled startup DDL

rules.requirement: Application credentials are supplied by a platform-generated Kubernetes Secret or a SealedSecret; no plaintext credential is committed to GitOps manifests.
rules.reason: operator Secret references and tracked manifests
